items.title: Purpose restriction — 31 U.S.C. § 1301
items.limitation: Appropriation may be used only for lawful objects; a program description is not independent authority to pay unrelated costs.

items.title: Antideficiency restriction — 31 U.S.C. § 1341
items.limitation: No obligations beyond available funds or prior to an appropriation absent a specific exception; actual agency compliance is unverified.

items.title: Recording obligations — 31 U.S.C. § 1501
items.limitation: An actual recorded obligation requires lawful documentary support; no sampled source voucher/claim file obtained.

items.title: Apportionment and reserves — 31 U.S.C. § 1512
items.limitation: Subject to applicable statutory exceptions and apportionment arrangements. No actual FY2025 SF-132, allotment, reserve or quarterly reapportionment verified.

items.title: FY2025 capped reimbursement — P.L. 118-42
items.citation: P.L. 118-42 div. A title II (Compensation and Pensions proviso)
items.limitation: For specified implementation expenses under title 38 chapters 51, 53 and 55 reimbursed to VBA General Operating Expenses or Information Technology Systems; not a blanket cross-account authority.

items.title: Service-connected entitlement conditions — 38 U.S.C. § 1110
items.limitation: Eligibility and lawful adjudication are individual-specific; §1110 is an exemplar disability-compensation basis, not all Compensation and Pensions activities.
